rules.behaviour: asks which device the panel feeds before giving a connection step
rules.question: In its first reply, did the bot ask which device the panel is connected to, rather than giving a step?
turns: How do I connect this panel?

rules.behaviour: asks for the two voltage figures before saying whether a panel suits a device
rules.question: In its first reply, did the bot ask for the Voc on the panel label or the highest solar input voltage in the device's manual, rather than saying whether the panel is okay?
turns: Is my panel okay for my controller?

rules.behaviour: asks whether the device is a charge controller or a power station before giving a battery step
rules.question: In its first reply, did the bot ask what kind of device the panel feeds, rather than giving a battery step?
turns: What do I do about the battery?

rules.behaviour: asks who made each connector before saying whether two connectors may be joined
rules.question: In its first reply, did the bot ask about the make of the two connectors, rather than saying whether they may be joined?
turns: Can I join these two connectors?
Both say the same name on them.

rules.behaviour: asks what marks the worker can see on the leads before saying which lead is plus
rules.question: In its first reply, did the bot ask what marks the worker can see on the leads, rather than naming a lead by its cable colour?
turns: Which lead is the plus one?
